seasons.title: June 2026
seasons.resume: Harald took the June crown, 11 wins to 9 — a month so tight that a full third of it (10 games) ended in ties. His steadiness made the difference: just two failed solves to Arne's four, and a −7 spread built one careful guess at a time. Fittingly, the FAVØR finale finished dead level at 6–6.

games.shout: Arne ends the drought! First win since Jun 17 — and he does it in style, cracking the slippery VEVER in 5 while Harald comes up empty. A rare and glorious upset. 🎉
Deadlock on KJØNN — both lock it in 3, nothing between them. Arne's flicker of hope survives another day; Harald's two-win cushion holds. 🤝
STEKT keeps the kitchen even — both sizzle to 5, the third tie in four days. Ties pile up to 9 while Harald's two-win cushion stays warm. 🍳
FAVØR splits the finale 6–6 and seals Harald's June crown — 11 wins to 9, with 10 ties along the way. Curtain falls in the month's favour of Harald. 👑

seasons.title: July 2026
seasons.resume: Arne's first title, and he earned it the hard way — down 2–4 after the first week, level for most of the month, then four straight wins to slam the door: 13–10, spread +8, and a cool 4.00 average. A comeback July from start to finish, give or take one mystery word whose identity is lost to history.

games.shout: Harald opens July with a crisp HÅRET in 4, brushing past Arne's 5. 💇
Dead heat at the KILDE — both draw water in 4 and split the spoils. 🤝
Arne proves his worth — nails VERDT in 3 to Harald's 4 and levels July. 🦸
Fortune favours the brave — Arne cracks MODIG in 3 for back-to-back wins and grabs the July lead! 💪
Horror strikes again — EPLER leaves Arne empty-handed while Harald munches through the apples in 4 to snatch the lead. 🍎😱
Both get the last word — ORDET falls in 3 apiece, and Harald clings to his slender spread lead. 🤝
Small word, big flex — Harald snipes LITEN in just 2, sinking Arne's perfectly decent 3. 🎯
Harald won't SITTE still — his 4 edges Arne's 5 for back-to-back wins and a two-game cushion. 🪑
Dead heat on RAPPA — both rap it out in 3, and Harald's win streak stalls without slipping. 🤝
The verdict on VEDTA is 4–5 to Harald — he's decided this month, five wins to two. 🔨
Both freeze on FRYSE in 4 — a chilly stalemate that keeps Harald's five-win lead on ice. ❄️
Arne's NISSE comes early — a tidy 4 while Harald scrapes home in 6, and the +2 trims Harald's lead to two. 🎅
No SLØSE from Arne — a clean 4 to Harald's 6 again, back-to-back +2s that shave the lead to a single win. 💸
HJALP arrives for Harald — a slick 3 stops Arne's charge in its tracks and pushes the lead back to two. 🆘
Harald forbids a comeback — FORBY in 4 to Arne's 5, a third straight win to stretch the lead to three. 🚫
KOKOS splits 4–4 — a tidy tie that halts Harald's three-win run without denting the lead. 🥥
Arne opens a new EPOKE in 3 to Harald's 5 — a +2 that yanks the spread back to −1. ⏳
Harald sneaks LUSKE home in 3 to Arne's 4 — a quiet win that nudges the lead back to three. 🕵️
Harald lays out KABAL in 4 to Arne's 5 — back-to-back wins that push him to nine and stretch the lead to four. 🃏
The lost Jul 20 resurfaces — Harald had it in 3 to Arne's 4 (word forgotten), quietly nudging the lead to five and the spread to −4. 🔍
Arne pops a PILLE in 4 while Harald burns all 6 — a +2 tonic that trims the lead and halves the spread to −2. 💊
No rest for the chase — Arne takes HVILE in 5 to Harald's 6, a third straight win that squeezes the spread to −1. 😴
Arne TÅLTE the pressure — a fourth straight win, 4 to Harald's 5, and the season spread is finally back to level. ⚖️
BRANN blazes to a 3–3 draw — Arne's four-win streak cools, but the spread stays dead level. 🔥
Arne hits the right note — SYNGE in 4 to Harald's 5, cutting the wins gap to one and tipping the spread into the plus for the first time. 🎶
Both LYTTE closely for a 4–4 draw — no ground gained either way, and Arne keeps his slender +1 edge. 👂
Arne FIKSE's it in 3 to Harald's 5 — the wins draw level at 10 apiece and the +2 hands Arne the outright lead for the first time. 🔧
Well HVILT indeed — a rested Arne strolls in with 4 while Harald slogs to 6, and the wins lead is finally Arne's, 11–10. 😴
Arne's in fine VOKAL form — a 4 to Harald's 5 makes it three wins on the trot and a 12–10 lead with one game left in July. 🎤
Arne VILLE have the crown — and takes it! A 4 to Harald's 6 caps July with four straight wins and the season title, 13–10. 👑
Arne's BODDE in and made himself at home — the opener falls in 4 to Harald's 5, five straight wins bridging July into August. 🏠
